1442:         - name: Pump
1443:           description: The goroutine that reads the process, logs every line, feeds the machine and the loop, and executes what they return.
1444:           behavior: >
1445:             Declares in daemon/pump.go, over the Daemon of daemon/daemon.go (its fields d.deps, d.mu, d.projects and the proj fields machine, proc,
1446:             state, pumps; its helpers d.execute and d.writeLine, both called with d.mu held): an init func setting daemon.go's startPump to a function
1447:             (called by the spawn action with d.mu held) that stores a new done channel in the project's pumps map under p and starts
1448:             `go` d.pump(ctx, project, p, l); when pump returns the goroutine closes the channel and deletes the map entry under d.mu (the map
1449:             never grows past the live pumps); `func (d *Daemon) pump(ctx context.Context, project string, p
1450:             claude.Process, l *eventlog.Log)`; and `func (d *Daemon) Wait(project string)`: under d.mu it takes the done channels of the project's pumps
1451:             whose process is not the current one, releases d.mu and waits for each (immediate when none; tests call it once a newer spawn replaced the
1452:             process or an exit was handled). pump: for every line from p.Lines(), the whole handling under d.mu (so a caller that sees the line
1453:             in Events sees its effects too): now := Now(); l.Append("out", msg, now) where msg is the line when json.Valid, else
1454:             json.Marshal(string(line)) (an append error ignored); ev, err := stream.Parse(line) (err → the next line); when p is not the
1455:             project's current process, nothing more (the line stays in its own log); else loop.Event(now); macts :=
1456:             machine.Apply(ev, now); by ev.Type: "result" with a Result → lacts := loop.Turn(*ev.Result, now, Config.Loop); "rate_limit_event" with
1457:             Limits → lacts := loop.Limits(*ev.Limits, now, Config.Loop); then each machine action in order: "write" → d.writeLine(project, Line); "ask"
1458:             → Post(ctx, project, "ask", Headline, Numbers); "turn" → Post(ctx, project, "idle", the loop's Phase + " turn ended: " + the first 200
1459:             runes of Headline (or "(no text)" when Headline is empty), Numbers); "limit" → nothing; then d.execute(ctx, project, lacts) (which saves
1460:             the State; never d.Execute, which locks); then, for a "result" event only, d.finishDone(ctx, project, p) (a phase_done left pending for
1461:             this process runs now, after Turn has put the turn's total_cost_usd into SessionUSD: the end check, the kill, the next phase or the stop
1462:             with the stretch that counts this turn). When Lines() closes: st := <-p.Exit(); under d.mu: first the exit goes into the process's
1463:             own log l as its own entry, l.Append("exit", json.Marshal of {"code": st.Code, "stderr": tail}, Now()) where tail is the last 20
1464:             lines of st.Stderr (one trailing "\n" trimmed first, then split on "\n", the last 20 kept, joined with "\n"; "" when stderr is
1465:             empty) — a crash is never invisible: the code and the stderr are readable by GET events; then, if p is still the current process:
1466:             when a pending done is held for p → the current process is cleared (nil) and d.finishDone(ctx, project, p) (the session ended itself
1467:             after phase_done: the end batch runs, its kill finds no process, Exited is not called — not a crash); else the current process is
1468:             cleared (nil) and d.execute(ctx, project, loop.Exited(st.Code, st.Stderr, Now(), Config.Loop)) (the loop decides whether that exit is
1469:             a crash: it restarts within the per-hour cap or stops with kind "crash"); else nothing more (a process replaced by a newer spawn is
1470:             pumped to its end and its exit is logged but changes nothing).
